x:c.x:v: Synapse study-content ingestion: course code/title + curriculum description/topics + real syllabus/material links where publicly accessible.
49 individually verified starter course records across Waterloo, Laurier and U of T divisions.
This file is deliberately not labelled complete. The universities contain thousands of courses, and current official sites do not expose a single downloadable public corpus of all instructor syllabi.
The study-topic text in this workbook is a concise paraphrase of official calendar/department descriptions, not copied full-text syllabus material.
Included/linked only when an official department publicly exposes them. Many current syllabi live behind institutional LMS/Outline/SharePoint authentication.
Some Waterloo units state that course outlines are for viewing only and may not be copied or published without prior written consent.
Laurier's student guide directs students to retrieve the syllabus within the course's MyLearningSpace content.
Availability is decentralized. Some UTSC departments publish archives; other U of T units use authenticated SharePoint/LMS or registrar archives.
Use official catalogue descriptions as the universal baseline and treat instructor syllabi as an optional enrichment layer when access/licensing permits.
